scripts.sync: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path src -Recurse -Include '*.js' | ForEach-Object { $dest = $_.FullName -replace '^src', 'functions'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $dest) -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $dest -Force }"
scripts.deploy: npm run sync && firebase deploy --only functions
